# TokenBel

> Aggregator of Belarusian investment tokens and securities: catalog of tokens and issuers, secondary market statistics, yield and financial analytics.

TokenBel helps private investors in Belarus find, compare and track investment tokens and bonds issued by Belarusian companies. The platform aggregates data from Finstore, Bynex, Fainex, Whitebird and other venues, providing filters, ratings, alerts and a payout calendar. Page content is in Russian.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Catalog of tokens and issuing companies with key yield parameters.
- [Pricing](/pricing/): Free Standard plan and professional Pro (9 BYN/month) with advanced filters and alerts.
- [FAQ](/faq/): Answers about tokens, APY, ROI, risks and financial ratios.
- [Secondary market statistics](/statistics/secondmarket/): Trading volumes by platform, top tokens and issuers, daily dynamics.
- [RSS](/rss/): RSS feeds for new token issues and catalog updates.
- [Contacts](/contacts/): Contact the TokenBel team (issuers and investors).
- [Login](/login/): Sign in to the dashboard via Google, Telegram, Microsoft or Yandex.

## Optional

- [FAQ (markdown)](/faq.md): Full FAQ in markdown for LLM indexing.
- [Agent auth](/auth.md): How agents get access (anonymous public access, MCP, registration).
- [Dashboard](https://dashboard.tokenbel.info): Investor dashboard with favorites, notifications and analytics.

## Markdown versions (Markdown for Agents)

Every page is available as clean markdown. A request with the `Accept: text/markdown` header returns the markdown version; browsers get HTML.
